correctness.rationale: Every section is f(u)+vg(u) of bidegrees deg f<=2, deg g<=1. Two full ruling fibers force dimension <=1. For rank 2 any full fiber leaves at most one off-fiber common zero, giving exactly the (u-a)<u-b,v-c> family; with none, at most one per fiber. For rank 3, pairwise determinants deg<=3 vanishing at t>=4 fibers imply rational proportionality, contradicting independence of three generators; consequently only full-fiber spaces optimize. Rank 1 and ranks 4/5 follow from degree/root bounds and independent evaluation maps. Exhaustive enumeration of every RREF subspace for q=5 and 7 reproduces all 5 maxima/counts; finite checks are corroborative, not infinity proof.
